question: The amount at the end of the 2nd and 3rd years on a certain principal at CI is {₹}9,680 and {₹}10,648 respectively. Find the principal.
solution:
**Given:**

Amount at the end of the 2nd year (A₂) = ₹9,680

Amount at the end of the 3rd year (A₃) = ₹10,648

**Formula used:**

Aₙ = P × (1 + r/100)ⁿ

Where, P = Principal, r = rate of interest, n = time

**Calculation:**

A₃/
